description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1742/9 of 24.01.2012, Homagama D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 520022 & other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections to land parcel numbers, extents (hectares), and other particulars related to land titles across various districts in Sri Lanka. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on cadastral mapping, land parcel identification, and title registration amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
